nodes.label: dip-and-pull operando/in-situ XPS
nodes.description:
dip-and-pull operando/in-situ XPS
Owner organization: CNRS/Unistra
Task: T2.4
Maturity: established method
Documentation: Article in preparation. Example of cells can be found here: 10.1088/1361-6463/abd2ed
Range of validity or processability: 
Invalid in the current design for bubble generation reactions (OER, HER). Difficultly valid for any reaction where a high current density is used (i.e., will modify the properties of the electrolyte at the analysis spot). A mitigation method consists in using dip-and-pull 'in situ', i.e., dipping the electrode in the solution, performing the measurment, pulling it out of the solution and analyzing)
